characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: A regal and authoritative figure with a commanding presence. He is of average height with a slightly stocky build. His silver hair is neatly combed and he sports a well-groomed beard. The King wears a crown adorned with jewels and a rich robe of deep velvet with gold trims. His expression is stern yet wise, as he advises his twelve sons on their quest.

characters.name: Tolv Sønner
characters.description: The twelve sons are handsome and well-built, each standing tall with a heroic demeanor. They have an air of youthful exuberance, all equipped in shining armor and helmets, with capes flowing behind them. Each son is mounted on a sturdy horse, their expressions bold and determined as they set off on their journey.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: A young man with a humble and unassuming appearance. He is slightly shorter than his brothers and of a lean build. Askeladden has tousled brown hair and a thoughtful face, often reflecting worry or contemplation. He wears simple, worn clothes rather than armor, and his demeanor is kind-hearted and introspective.

characters.name: Den Lille Pige fra Græsset
characters.description: An enchanting and ethereal figure, initially appearing as a minuscule, delicate girl emerging from the grass. She is exquisitely beautiful with long, flowing hair and a soft aura. When she later grows to a normal size, she possesses an otherworldly beauty, dressed in a shimmering gown with intricate floral motifs. Her demeanor is gentle and enchanting, exuding a magical presence.

characters.name: Kærestene til Brødrene
characters.description: The brides chosen by the twelve brothers who appear disheveled and unattractive. They have unkempt hair with soot and tar-streaked hats that have run down onto their faces. Their clothes are untidy, and their expressions sullen and dissatisfied, having been mistreated on the journey.
